run_unit_tests: run the fasttext unit tests using the runtests.py script with the --unit-tests flag
run_integration_tests: run the fasttext integration tests by providing a data directory path with --data-dir
run_tests_verbosity: run fasttext tests with a custom verbosity level using the --verbose argument
review_run_tests_function: review the run_tests function that loads and executes a unittest TestSuite with TextTestRunner
test_gen_unit_tests: test the gen_unit_tests function to generate unit test cases with configurable verbosity
